import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='pclass', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Gender', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival count by embarkation point
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, 
                     color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], width=0.6)
ax3.set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Point and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(['Died', 'Survived'], title='Status', loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare distribution by class with survival overlay
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    class_data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]
    survived_data = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare']
    died_data = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare']
    
    ax4.scatter(died_data, [pclass] * len(died_data), alpha=0.4, s=30, 
                color='#E74C3C', label='Died' if pclass == 1 else '')
    ax4.scatter(survived_data, [pclass] * len(survived_data), alpha=0.4, s=30,
                color='#2ECC71', label='Survived' if pclass == 1 else '')

ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_yticks([1, 2, 3])
ax4.set_yticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax4.legend(loc='upper right')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_xlim(-10, 300)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
